page_title: TOT 2-2 WOL | Tottenham Hotspur v Wolves 29/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+12' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+12' One of the players from Tottenham times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+12' Good movement by Timo Werner (Tottenham), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
90+11' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Dejan Kulusevski, but Jose Sa displays great awareness to stop him.
90+7' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+7' Sergio Reguilon (Tottenham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
90+7' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+5' The game is interrupted now, Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+3' What a chance that is! Dejan Kulusevski swings the ball into the box, and Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the right post.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.

90' What a great chance for Matt Doherty (Wolves). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
90' There's an opportunity for Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
90' Carlos Forbs (Wolves) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Now Wolves have a corner.
90' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

89' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Jose Sa makes a great save to stop his effort.
87' 2 - 2 Goal! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) takes a short pass from Rayan Ait-Nouri in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the roof of the net. 2:2.
86' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) is about to take a corner kick.
83' Tottenham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
82' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
78' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Craig Dawson.
78' Vitor Pereira has decided to make a change. Carlos Forbs (Wolves) replaces Hee-Chan Hwang.
74' Sergio Reguilon (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but Jose Sa comes off his line to gather the ball.
72' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:8.
71' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
70' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
70' An attempted cross from Nelson Semedo (Wolves) is cleared.
69' Vitor Pereira decides to make a substitution. Andre will be replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
67' Andre (Wolves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
66' A precise low pass is received by James Maddison (Tottenham), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
64' Substitution. Brennan Johnson is replaced by James Maddison (Tottenham).
64' Substitution. Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) replaces Yves Bissouma.
64' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Timo Werner (Tottenham) replacing Heung-Min Son.
63' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
61' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
58' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
57' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
57' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) was too forceful with his tackle and Chris Kavanagh interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
56' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
54' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
53' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
51' Tottenham are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
50' Problems for Ange Postecoglou as Destiny Udogie is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Sergio Reguilon (Tottenham) replaces him.
49' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
49' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Vitor Pereira probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves). He is replaced by Goncalo Guedes.
46' Half-time substitution. Vitor Pereira decided to make a change. Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is replaced by Jorgen Strand Larsen.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Chris Kavanagh has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' 2 - 1 Goal! Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Dejan Kulusevski, then sends the ball into the middle of the net. 2:1.
45+2' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the left side of the target, but Jose Sa pulls off a superb save.
42' Andre (Wolves) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul. Tottenham are awarded a penalty kick!

40' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) finds his teammate, who is lurking close to the offside line, with a nice through pass. The opponent's defence is having a really hard time dealing with these kind of situations.
40' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) steps up to send the ball in.
39' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Tottenham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
38' The corner is swung in but Tottenham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
36' That was close by Matheus Cunha (Wolves)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
34' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) attempts to whip a quick pass into the box, but Jean-Ricner Bellegarde was not able to dribble past the opponent's defence and loses the ball.
30' The game is interrupted as Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) is flagged offside.
29' The foul by Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) was seen by Chris Kavanagh who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
27' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
27' Wolves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

26' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
24' Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
24' The referee awards a corner and Pedro Porro (Tottenham) goes over to take it.
23' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
21' The game is interrupted now, Fraser Forster (Tottenham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
18' Matt Doherty (Wolves) is adjudged offside.
17' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul. Wolves win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
16' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
14' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post.
12' 1 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 1:1.
12' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
11' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Tottenham.
11' Tottenham have a free kick.
11' Joao Gomes (Wolves) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Chris Kavanagh signals.

7' 0 - 1 Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Rayan Ait-Nouri. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the bottom right corner via the woodwork. 0:1!
7' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
7' A player from Tottenham takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Nelson Semedo almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Matheus Cunha (Wolves) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
3' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
2' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Tottenham will kick the game off.
Chris Kavanagh will officiate today.
